lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with spatial density decreasing in the dorsal-ward direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a grid-like alignment particularly visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more tightly packed than those on the lateral flank.
